## Name the data frame verb

```{r example-shortanswer-answer, echo=FALSE}
q_example_shortanswer_answer <- "filter"
```

Which dplyr verb keeps rows that satisfy a condition? Give its name without
parentheses.

**Answer:** `r quiz_shortanswer(q_example_shortanswer_answer)`

::: unilur-solution
The `filter()` verb keeps rows that satisfy a condition.
:::
